cohort_selection: First 1000 future fixtures in pinned snapshot, sorted by original scheduled_date, league, fixture_id; set is never extended to replace missing forecasts.

forecast_policy.generation: Before 12:00 UTC on the day before the scheduled match date. First publicly recorded forecast wins; local timestamps alone are insufficient.
forecast_policy.features: Rolling results strictly BEFORE the UTC generation calendar date; no outcomes from generation day or later. Weights, preprocessing, formulas remain fixed.
forecast_policy.publication: Each batch hash and protocol hash must be publicly recorded before kickoff; missing proof makes coverage incomplete.
forecast_policy.rescheduling: Keep fixture identity and first admissible published forecast. Report original and actual dates. No outcome-dependent exclusions or replacement fixtures.
forecast_policy.new_versions: Any weight/calibration/feature change is a separate registered experiment; it does not replace this one.

evaluation.final_only: Evaluate only once all 1000 cohort games have outcomes AND 1000 admissible pre-match forecasts are publicly evidenced. Otherwise report incomplete coverage without a confirmatory claim. No optional stopping or adding games until significance.
evaluation.primary_metric: Mean paired log loss difference: boosting minus logistic_since2010
evaluation.primary_interval: Paired cluster bootstrap by calendar month of actual match date; resample all observed months with replacement, count-weighted match mean; 20000 repetitions, seed=0, percentile 95% CI.
evaluation.decision: Boosting counts as better only if upper endpoint of the primary 95% CI is strictly below zero. Otherwise superiority is not established; zero-crossing is not proof of equivalence.
evaluation.market_secondary: Only after primary criterion passes, compare boosting vs AvgCH/AvgCD/AvgCA closing probabilities with multiplicative margin removal on the identical covered subset, using the same monthly interval. Require >=95% valid closing coverage and upper endpoint <0 for a market-superiority statement restricted to that subset. No profitability inference.
evaluation.odds_missing: No fallback to opening odds or different providers; list unmatched/invalid rows, compare models only on the identical market-covered subset.
diagnostics: Classwise Brier vs frozen league frequency baseline
Calibration tables without fitting new calibration on prospective outcomes
evaluation.small_block_warning: Report number of month blocks; a small number of blocks limits bootstrap reliability even if nominal criterion passes.

power.dependence_and_drift: These are approximate independent stationary calculations; dependencies may require more data.

relation_to_144: Existing 144-match static-feature snapshot remains unchanged and is a separate pilot. This main experiment uses rolling past-result features, never mixes versions post-hoc.
automation_status: No background scheduler or future automatic publication configured. Future daily generation/publication requires an operator.
timestamp_note: Local creation is not independent proof. Public remote commit and receipt are recorded separately.
